doc: The Limen Core manifest (kemiller2002/limen#59, #60): what Core is, as data the checks read. Core is the universal boundary mechanism every ordinary Limen application shares, and nothing else. tools/guardrails/core.ts checks the repository against this file (scripts/check-architecture.ts, npm test); it is guardrail-owned (architecture/guardrails.json), so feature work cannot widen it. Enlarging Core — a file, a root export family, a binding primitive, a capability family, a runtime dependency, a concept — needs a Core Admission record (docs/core-admission.md).

concepts.statement: The engine owns meaning and authoritative state.
Semantic events and facts travel into the engine.
Projection travels out to the browser.
Browser authority is requested through typed capabilities and returned as typed outcomes.
Correlation and compatibility make asynchronous and cross-runtime behavior explicit.

runtimeRoots.doc: Every file under these directories is runtime source and must belong to exactly one layer of architecture/layers.json.

layers.doc: Every layer in architecture/layers.json is Core or belongs to exactly one optional group. Core may import only Core; an optional layer may import only Core's public files.

files.doc: The exact Core files. A new file in a Core layer that is not listed here fails the check: Core does not grow by adding a path. public: an extension point optional layers may import. private: Core-internal. generated: emitted by tools/contract-gen, measured separately from handwritten Core.

entrypoints.doc: Package subpaths that expose Core. Every other subpath in package.json exports is optional and must resolve outside Core layers' private files.

rootExports.doc: Every name the root entrypoint (src/index.ts) exports belongs to exactly one approved family, and every family to one canonical concept. A new family, or a name in no family, fails. legacy lists names still exported from the root that are not Core; they are removed by kemiller2002/limen#61 and may not grow.

bindingPrimitives.doc: The DOM binding primitives the kernel reads. data-key is a required modifier of data-each, not a primitive. Any other data-* attribute a Core file reads is an undeclared primitive.

capabilityFamilies.doc: The built-in browser capability families, grandfathered at v1. They are the EffectRequest variants of contract/core.contract.json other than the generic optional-capability seam, and the values of its Capability enum. A new browser capability is an optional pack (docs/24-contract-and-capabilities.md).

limits.doc: Frozen at architectureVersion 1.0.0. Raising one needs an approved Core Admission and a new architecture version.
